name: Network Manager (with Repeater & Hotspot)
author: Gunesh Bari
description: Complete network manager for Omarchy featuring Wi-Fi, simultaneous Wi-Fi Repeater chaining & Hotspot AP with centered QR sharing, 1-click linux-wifi-hotspot installer, DNS selection, and interactive Wired Ethernet configuration (DHCP & Static IP) with full keyboard navigation.

barWidget.description: Network status, Wi-Fi, Repeater, Hotspot, wired Ethernet, and DNS
